cyberattack: Other: Open-redirect abuse leading to suspected credential phishing
data.description:
Adding to the Canadian government exploit leads: open-redirect exploitation evidence involving www.ville.laval.qc.ca (City of Laval, Quebec; municipal government).

Two URLQuery captures on May 6, 2026 record the same submitted URL/redirect chain. The main report is timestamped 16:47:17 UTC; the earlier capture is around 16:37 UTC. The municipal endpoint /wlav2/wlav.w3_pub.initSession received an external destination in its url parameter. Its archived response was HTTP 302 Found, and the Location header contained the supplied external address on crownprincemohammedbinsalman.online. That destination then returned HTTP 303 to an HTML page hosted on Google Cloud Storage; the final response was HTTP 200 with the title Webmail Login.

The saved scanner screenshot shows a cPanel-style webmail login form requesting a password. Together, the redirect headers and screenshot support observed open-redirect abuse leading to suspected credential phishing. These are two captures of the same episode, not evidence of two distinct attacks.

Evidence links below: main report; earlier capture; main report raw JSON for checking response status and Location headers; saved screenshot.
data.summary: Two May 6 URLQuery captures show Laval’s municipal website redirecting to an externally supplied destination, then to a webmail password form. Archived headers support open-redirect abuse leading to suspected phishing;
